text:
elaine (People Ops): Quick Q — we have an IC leveling move (L3 -> L4) approved by manager. Need checklist: what docs do we need and how do we request backpay?

matthew (Eng Manager): Thanks! I submitted the leveling form yesterday. Main ask: how do we attach performance notes? Also want effective date to be start of Q1.

sarah (Compensation): For lateral/level changes we need: 1) completed leveling form (done), 2) manager justification (short bulleted doc), 3) peer/skip feedback summary (if available), and 4) L4 salary band recommendation. Put them in the leveling folder and ping me.

elaine (People Ops): @sarah got it. For backpay: do we automatically calculate from effective date or need a separate backpay request?

sarah (Compensation): We need a backpay approval for anything > 30 days retro. If effective date is start of Q1 and today is mid-Q2, that'll need approval path (comp partner + finance). If < 30 days retro, payroll can process as an adjustment in the next cycle.

matthew (Eng Manager): Understood. If we ask for backpay, what info does payroll need to compute amount?

jordan (Payroll): Payroll needs: employee ID, old salary, new salary, effective date, reason code (PROMO/LEVELUP), and whether to treat as lump-sum or recurring adjustment. Also any tax handling notes. You can send via the payroll request form or SCIM ticket.

elaine (People Ops): Is there a template for the manager justification? I can draft but want to match expectations.

sarah (Compensation): Template: 3 short bullets: impact & scope, stretch responsibilities added, calibration evidence (peer note or project outcome). Keep < 200 words. Example: "Led infra migration reducing inference latency 20%, owns cross-team roadmap, mentors 2 juniors."

matthew (Eng Manager): Perfect. For the recommendation band — is it a single salary number or range?

sarah (Compensation): Provide a recommended target salary and suggested percentile (e.g., 50th of band). Compensation team will propose final band and sign-off.

elaine (People Ops): Clarify approvals: manager -> comp -> finance -> payroll? Or does People Ops route?

ryan (People Ops): People Ops routes the paperwork once manager uploads attachments. If backpay required we route to Finance for sign-off after comp approves. For standard promos without retro >30d we just notify payroll.

matthew (Eng Manager): Timeline expectations? We have an upcoming offer cycle so need this done in 2 weeks if possible.

sarah (Compensation): Comp review typically 3 business days if docs complete. Finance sign-off for backpay can add 2–5 business days. Payroll processing lead time: next payroll cycle + 1 cycle for lump-sum.

elaine (People Ops): Any risk flags that trigger executive review?

sarah (Compensation): Yes: exotics like >20% bump, manager-level hire-into-role, or concurrent equity refreshs might need GC/exec. We'll flag if it hits any rule.

matthew (Eng Manager): One more — internal transfer across teams with leveling change. Does it impact start-of-role probation or promo cadence?

ryan (People Ops): Transfers that include a level change reset the promo clock: new level's review cadence applies. If it's purely lateral without comp change, cadence stays. We’ll confirm in the onboarding checklist.

matthew (Eng Manager): Okay. I'll upload manager justification + peer notes now. Can you confirm receipt and next steps?

elaine (People Ops): Please put files in: /company/people-ops/leveling_submissions/YYYY-MM/1918765432-matthew-l4. Ping me when done.

payroll-bot: Reminder: payroll requests must not contain PII in public channels. Use the secure payroll form: https://redwood/payroll/request

matthew (Eng Manager): Uploaded and pinged.

elaine (People Ops): Received. @sarah starting comp review — I'll route to finance if backpay requested. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sarah (Compensation): Quick note on backpay calc snippet for payroll (copy/paste):

```
Backpay = (new_annual_salary - old_annual_salary) / 12 * months_retro
If lump_sum, include gross amount and tax withholding instructions.
```

jordan (Payroll): Received calc. We'll confirm tax treatment in the ticket. Expect an update by next Thu.

matthew (Eng Manager): Appreciate it. Any escalation if finance delays?

ryan (People Ops): If we hit >1 week delay after comp approval, escalate to the Finance partner oncall and cc the People Ops director. I'll add escalation contacts to the checklist doc.

elaine (People Ops): Adding final checklist summary here for thread closure: 1) leveling form, 2) manager justification (<200 words), 3) peer/skip notes, 4) comp target recommendation, 5) request backpay if >30d retro, 6) People Ops routes to Finance (if needed), 7) Payroll processes. I'll drop this into the leveling templates folder.
